versions.changelog:
- Removed the sample file skill-card.md.
- Updated SKILL.md with revised examples and receipt number formats.
- Simplified the skill description.

Initial release of uscis-case-status.

- Check USCIS case status by receipt number using Selenium and undetected-chromedriver.
- Simple command-line interface: python3 -m uscis_case_status <CASE_NUMBER>.
- Supports common receipt formats (IOC, NSC, IOE, SRC).
- Outputs case number, last update date, and status message.
- Works headless via Xvfb; requires chromium-browser on system.
- Includes error handling for invalid case numbers and notes about rate limits/timeouts.
